title: Edmund and the Contact
author: Zephyrine Blackwood
blurb: Vesper Galloway, a whistle-blower living under four names, has spent twenty years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must get the truth past three governments and one assassin, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
